Blade Lineage?
剑契组？

Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... Mentor. What is this?
……这是怎么回事，头领？

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I recognize these wounds. These are your techniques...!
这不是……头领的剑术吗。这伤痕……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
You... how could you put your blade to our fellows!!
他们……您是伤害了我们的友人吗！！

Attempting to communicate seems futile.
似乎无法沟通。

Pitch-black flames lingered behind this man she called 'Bamboo-hatted Kim'. Her mentor...
金笠，被称作头领的那人身后涌动着黑色的热浪。

Something had devoured him. There was something in his eyes...
他那似乎被某物吞噬的身姿，以及似乎寄宿着某物的瞳孔中……

Fiendish Malevolence.
邪气。

I could definitely sense it. This was a Distortion.
我能明确感知到……那是扭曲。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Cease your beastly howls and talk to me, please! Say someth—
不要再像野兽似的吼叫了，请您说句话！说点什么……

Oi! Don't get too close...!
喂！别靠近……

The Distortion unsheathed its blade in the blink of an eye. It sensed that something had entered its range.
也许是进入了他的感知范围，那扭曲以肉眼不可见的速度拔出剑，摆出战斗架势。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
That stance...! You're really going to kill—
这形势……是要杀了……

G-get out of the way!
快、快躲开！

As Aeng-du stood there confused, Sinclair urgently hurled himself in her direction. And in that brief moment, the Distortion's blade descended upon them as though it bisected the very space they inhabited.
辛克莱瞬间扑向惊慌的樱桃，下一刻那仿佛要将空间劈为两半的剑刃便猛然切下。

I surmise that Sinclair has entered the Distortion's range as well.
辛克莱也已进入范围。

<We have no choice but to suppress it.>
<看样子只能进行镇压了。>

We tensed up, sensing the changing atmosphere. We slowly raised our weapons.
感受到气氛逐渐变得紧张，我们慢慢握紧了武器……
